scope: Follow-up of the 54 functions previously supported only by browser/module tests. Twenty now have additional finite original-runtime comparisons; six have partial GUI observations; 28 still lack the requested new direct comparison.
fixedDifferences: Ctrl-drag rotates templates as specified by the original handler; Shift is an additional browser alias. Paired original GUI rotation remains pending.
ZIP job/result label includes archive stem and full XML filename; loose files retain their full filename.
Windows login preparation rejects generated usernames shorter than five characters.
Single Testtaker XML uses the input workbook stem, as in the original.
Windows mode reproduces mode loss after clearing an existing shared-string password cell. Extended mode retains valid modes.
Booklet validation retains later phase diagnostics; complete Booklet/Login messages can be exported with original wording, CRLF and UTF-16 LE.

additionalSourceCorrection.browserCorrection: Ctrl-drag now rotates. Shift-drag is retained as an additional browser shortcut.
additionalSourceCorrection.browserAssertion: At 200% scale, a 40 CSS-pixel downward drag rotates -20 degrees and preserves translation. Both modifiers and reset-on-case-change are tested.
additionalSourceCorrection.reason: Original-source contract verified; an observed paired native Ctrl-drag GUI run is still pending.

captureMethods: Normal original Windows GUIs operated in UTM Windows 11 ARM64; original result, XML, workbook and Texteditor bytes transferred without editing.
Unchanged original Booklet/Login dialog workers executed in a separate x64 Windows CI process; their complete inputs/outputs are retained in the verified artifact.
normalizations: Independent interaction timestamps are excluded only for independently repeated actions; native result import/export retains exact timestamps.
Random login/password/group suffix values are checked for alphabet, length, uniqueness and prefix/group semantics, not equal random draws.
XML indentation, empty Testlet label attribute and ZIP/Excel metadata/styles are outside semantic equality.
Browser filenames replace the unavailable absolute Windows input path in message comparisons.
The fresh report JSON outer line endings are normalized for Git; base64 file captures and their SHA-256 values are unchanged.

remainingBlocker: The Mac locked during the next Toolbox GUI step. Computer use requires the user to unlock it manually. An unlock request is pending; no unobserved GUI workflow is marked passed.
limitations: Finite synthetic inputs and official templates; no empirical/anonymised study data.
This is not completion of all 54 requested original comparisons.
Installed Safari was not rerun for this revision. Current WebKit engine tests and mobile emulation do not establish physical-device or installed-Safari acceptance.
The pure browser version retains operating-system account/path/overwrite restrictions; the optional local starter is separate.
